set.body:
Outcome

Move all retained predictive, representational, effect, canonical, and global methods onto the new architecture without retaining parallel implementations.

Acceptance

- Each family has typed estimands and results.
- Existing numerical behavior is protected by independent oracles.
- Consumers migrate as each old path is removed.
- This gate closes only after every Phase 5 child closes.
set.title: P5: migrate every supported MVPA method family onto the new ontology
